body:
Track 3, milestone `chip-ppa-loop`. Rewrites of a 16-bit adder and 6x6 multiplier must be proved equivalent (Yosys miter) before cells and depth are scored; compared with a no-model parameter sweep at equal budget. Result is preliminary: best adder 0.85x reference cells*depth, tied by the sweep; no multiplier gain. Proposer is the session agent, not an LLM benchmark. Tests: 7 pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok.

Note: three classic adder citations (Bedrij, Kogge-Stone, Sklansky) are from memory and flagged unverified in the README.
